For Quarrendon Freight Lines the signed paperwork gives 185 seats now and 230 from January 1, 2027. Nothing supports the 261 Ilse posted. I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message with this answer.

- **2026 renewal (signed March 20, effective April 1, 2026, runs to March 31, 2027):** it doesn't change the seat count, so the 185 seats from Amendment No. 1 still apply.
- **Amendment No. 3 (signed September 22, 2026):** it takes the account to 230 seats starting January 1, 2027.
- **Account page:** it also lists 185 active seats.

I couldn't find 261 in any document. When Ilse posted it on October 14, I acknowledged it without checking. I told Dana that was my mistake and asked her to check with Ilse where 261 came from before putting it in the tracker. I left out all pricing, since that's a finance figure.
